decisionBasis.authority: Names, ownership, invariants and causal proof requirements are selected here. Native field/wire migration and runtime implementation remain separately verifiable work.

personalAdmission.identifiedRequestRule: IIdentifiedRequest.RequestId maps to the caller CommandId; reject missing/empty/malformed identity, never substitute context trace/request id.

http.body: existing authored purpose and optional complete consultant scope; all route identities canonical and cannot be replaced by query/body identity

personalAdmission.logicalOperationId: caller CommandId scoped to first owner
currentGuardsPreserved: Personal HTTP invocation only; no system actor; Bdgrz user maps to tenant member actor with display.
Ordinary caller: current exact SharedResource artifact EvidenceArtifactRead permission via IAccessGrantScopePermissionAuthorizer.

Consultant scope is all-or-none: nonempty ProgramId + AdvisorHandoffId + supported evidence-artifact SelectedSource matching ArtifactId, active shared-source authorization and sourceVersions.RequireCurrentAsync.

Capture actual canonical registration/current metadata and complete source prefix; artifact Available with nonfuture availability instant; content hash/length exact; physical source position must fit signed long.
IssueDeliveryAsync only for actual tenant/hash/length; absolute HTTPS or urn:bdgrz:artifact-delivery: URI; expiry > now and <= now + five minutes.
Recheck access and canonical metadata after ticket preparation; append checks unchanged physical position, Available state, hash and length.
RecordDownload validates exact business revision, request UUID, member kind/UUID/display<=200, IssuedAt>=RegisteredAt, canonical purpose and content tuple.
personalAdmission.admissionAuthorization: Current personal Bdgrz HTTP caller and exact artifact read right before native replay. Preserve ordinary current scoped permission path and all-or-none consultant program/handoff/selected-source authorization. Exact retry compares same original actor identity and normalized authored terms.
personalAdmission.frozenIntent: Exact canonical original request, root/actor/first-owner provenance, derived GrantId, actual content hash/length/head and available-inspection source/cut, complete optional handoff + explicit handling-policy requirements, maximum delivery lifetime. Freeze actual immutable default policy when selected; no absent-source surrogate.

atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.authority: The single committed EvidenceArtifactDownloadRequested fact simultaneously records admission and installs its exact local availability reservation/fence.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.predicate: Pin this artifact-owned available inspected content/head and exact generation for this admitted root through actual receiving issue or cancellation. Any artifact-owned mutation that would invalidate it must honor the reservation.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.identity: Exact first-owner artifact + root CommandId + receiving derived grant + purpose/generation; no global command uniqueness assumption.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.proofTiming: Before append, only prove actual already-saved predecessor/content sources. Never construct a proof of the future Requested fact. After append, derive and verify actual saved Requested source/metadata and local reservation authority; that fact proves the availability grant for foreign issue.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.bounds: Retain every active reservation legitimately needed for current authority; no arbitrary cap. Closed history/fences may be externalized only with verified immutable exact-cut authority.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.externalBoundary: This local hold does not claim an atomic transaction with foreign owners or physical content storage. Issue still proves actual stored content/URI and bounded lifetime; unavailable dependencies remain transient. No invented cross-owner permit or absence proof.

personalAdmission.originalResponse: Freeze the exact standard 202 OperationAcceptedResponse(CommandId, artifact-scoped status URL, original AcceptedAt) on first acceptance. Later receiving issuance never replaces or reconstructs that root first response.
personalAdmission.replayAndFailure: Current public authorization first; exact native original202 returns only for fully bound original intent/actor. Equal winner and unknown append recover actual committed acceptance; requested cancellation passes through. Availability/source conflict or corruption does not silently become cancellation without the selected proof.
personalAdmission.sourceEntry: current-authorized personal HTTP command, not an event subscription
personalAdmission.requestContract: IRequest<OperationAcceptedResponse>, IIdentifiedRequest; existing personal artifact mutation authorization retained

receivingIdentity.rootCommandIdentity: remains caller CommandId on tenant/artifact first owner

derivedGrantId.canonicalEncoding: Lowercase canonical hyphenated UUID strings of fixed width; fixed ASCII domain prefix and separator; validate UUID values before derivation. The tuple encoding is injective for these domains.
derivedGrantId.collisionBoundary: Distinct artifact namespaces and explicit tenant in name bytes prevent valid same-CommandId use on two artifact owners from selecting the same receiving identity. Full root owner/actor/intent tuple is still verified.

receivingIdentity.lookup: Derive receiving ID from the already scoped tenant/artifact/command tuple. No global root registry or public generic operation lookup.

receivingFlow.physicalRootRole: one durable Requested root starter; complete process record before reactor checkpoint advances
receivingFlow.completeCanonicalTargets: local artifact reservation plus every actual optional handoff and explicit/default handling source from frozen requirements. Canonical unsigned UTF8 stream-key acquisition order; final modes, no upgrades.

stages.rule: Acquire exactly complete foreign uses; handoff receiver skipped only when root selected no consultant/handoff scope. No separate availability acquire command: local Requested admission already owns it.

requiredActualTypedProofs: EvidenceArtifactDownloadRequested@v1 on exact artifact proving local available-content reservation
AdvisorArtifactDownloadUseAuthorized for exact selected handoff, iff required
ArtifactHandlingDownloadUseAuthorized for exact selected explicit/default immutable policy
stages.rule: Verify complete exact proof set and original personal root; freeze server issue DecisionAt/IssuedAt and check every temporal assertion/waiver interval then. Request AcceptedAt never authorizes delayed issuance after expiry.

requiredActualTypedProofs: EvidenceArtifactDownloadIssued@v2 on exact receiving grant OR ArtifactDownloadGrantCanceled on exact receiving grant
stages.rule: Actual published terminal fact proves exact disposition/key/generation. Settlement fences held and not-yet-held keys as selected; no inferred absence/release.

receivingFlow.issueOriginalTicket: Ask actual tenant-scoped content store for the exact content hash/length. Preserve absolute HTTPS/allowed delivery URN and >now / <=five-minute expiry checks. Write and verify confidential original ticket using IProtectedResponseContentStore before native receiving issuance. Only the committed winner can be read; never return unpublished candidates.
receivingFlow.protectedScope: exact tenant realm + affected receiving grant stream + root CommandId + original personal actor identity; authenticate exact schema/envelope/configured persistent key

abort.rule: Only a real provable pre-issue expiry/revocation/conflict or selected terminal ticket failure may cancel. Atomically fence delayed receiving issue before any source-use settlement. Unavailable content/store outcome remains transient unless a selected actual terminal proof exists. An issued winner always recovers forward.

receivingFlow.recovery: Admission reference remains only a locator. Independently verify typed root/stage/terminal facts and exact immutable terms before effects or any early replay not fully covered by receipt binding. Stable deterministic receiver identity and exact source proof set survive driver crash/unknown append/CAS races. Completed root202 and original ticket never renew.

effectIdentity.bytes: UTF8(effect-identity:v2) followed by each field UTF8 bytes prefixed by its unsigned32-bit big-endian byte length; UUIDv5 over these exact name bytes and the actual source EventId namespace.
effectIdentity.rule: Use only for this new unoccupied process identity domain; occupied v1 algorithms/target-key selections remain unchanged. Implementation must provide fixed byte/UUID vectors before activation.

scopedRead.identityRule: All identity comes from the canonical scoped path; misleading query identities cannot override it. Derive exact receiving GrantId locally, never scan a generic operation registry.
scopedRead.authorization: Current personal HTTP actor must match the original admitted personal actor identity AND still possess current exact artifact read rights/required current consultant handoff scope. Current rights alone do not authorize another actor original ticket; original actor alone does not bypass current rights. Use existing denial/concealment behavior for unauthorized or mismatched owner/root.
scopedRead.response: closed Pending / issued / canceled union, bound to same tenant/artifact/root command/GrantId

variants.authority: actual verified Requested admission, with no receiving terminal outcome yet provable
variants.contents: scoped identity + original accepted state/time; no ticket or guessed cancellation

variants.authority: actual receiving issued v2 plus authenticated encrypted original ticket/result and matching root/actor/proofs
variants.contents: same stored original ticket location and expiry, never regenerated or extended; return original expired ticket unchanged when authorized

variants.authority: actual receiving cancellation/fence bound to same root and generation
variants.contents: scoped canceled status and selected safe bounded failure code; no ticket

scopedRead.unavailableRule: Source/protected-result unavailability is transient, never guessed pending/canceled/absent authority; malformed/corrupt proof fails closed. A legitimately missing admitted root is not found.
scopedRead.noRenewal: Read and exact write retry cannot mint/refresh a ticket. A new authorized command is required for a new delivery.
scopedRead.legacyRule: Old artifact-issued v1 has no persisted native admission/encrypted ticket. Preserve historical metadata decoder/read behavior, but never fabricate a native grant or original ticket for it.
scopedRead.logicalPrerequisiteRule: Verified Requested admission AND the actual selected state: pending with no terminal yet provable, receiving issuedv2, or cancellation. These event variants are not an all-events requirement.

occupiedLegacy.legacySemantics: Read-only replay of v1 remains on EvidenceArtifact and advances its existing artifact revision. Historical metadata/snapshot readers currently consume this shape.

selectedReceivingIssued.concreteTypeRole: separate v2 native receiving fact; keep concrete legacy v1 decoder
selectedReceivingIssued.authority: Original artifact/root/actor provenance, complete typed source-use proof set, immutable intent, actual selected content tuple and protected original ticket/result.
selectedReceivingIssued.firstResponseSeparation: Personal first owner already recorded original202; receiving result cannot replace its first response.

eventMigration.compatibility: Legacy issued v1 stays read-only on EvidenceArtifact with exact original shape and artifact revision semantics. New receiving emits only v2; no replay conversion, owner reassignment of historical v1, or generated synthetic source. Historical/projector/snapshot consumers explicitly qualify version + owning stream + actual locator.
